It looks like there’s a little mix‑up: **Lawrence Bender is a film producer, not an actor**.  
He’s produced several of Quentin Tarantino’s early classics, so the best way to satisfy your “watch‑now” craving is to pick one of those Tarantino‑produced gems.

| Film | Year | Bender’s role | Tarantino’s role |
|------|------|---------------|------------------|
| **Reservoir Dogs** | 1992 | Producer | Director |
| **Pulp Fiction** | 1994 | Producer | Director |
| **Jackie Brown** | 1997 | Producer | Director |

All three are quintessential Tarantino, and they’re all widely available on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, etc.). If you’re looking for something a bit newer but still in that Tarantino‑Bender partnership, you could also check out **"The Hateful Eight"** (2015) – Bender produced it, Tarantino directed.

Let me know which one you’d like to dive into, or if you want help finding where to stream it!
